verdict.summary: Tapioca flour is naturally gluten-free and poses minimal risk for individuals with coeliac disease. However, cross-contamination during processing or preparation can occur.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.

sections.title: Common gluten risks
